chunks: So bring our ancestors back, if you are truthful.
ai.seo_question: Who spoke the words 'So bring our ancestors back, if you are truthful' in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse captures the Meccan disbelievers' arrogant dismissal of resurrection, challenging the Prophet to produce their forefathers as proof of his truthfulness. In Shia exegesis, this reflects their materialistic worldview that rejected the unseen (ghayb), a theme echoed in the Imams' teachings on the necessity of faith in the afterlife despite its invisibility to the senses. Their challenge underscores the divine power to resurrect even the most distant generations, affirming the reality of the Day of Judgment.
